data.one_liner: Strongly-typed postgres ORM providing easy bindings between Dart classes and PostgreSQL databases.
data.what_it_does: Stormberry maps Dart classes to a PostgreSQL database using annotations and code generation. It supports all kinds of relations without complex configuration and handles database migrations.
use_when: You are building a Dart or Flutter backend that uses PostgreSQL.
You want strongly-typed database models and automatic code generation for relations and queries.
avoid_when: You are using a non-relational database or a SQL database other than PostgreSQL.
You prefer writing raw SQL queries or manual mappers without code generation.
strengths: Easy relation handling without complex configuration
weaknesses: Requires re-running build_runner for model changes
data.setup_notes: Add stormberry and build_runner, set up annotated model classes with part files, run build_runner, and use the stormberry migrate tool.

alternatives.name: drift
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a robust SQLite-based local database solution instead of a remote PostgreSQL database.
